methodology.description: Synthetic dataset generated and ingested via CSV loaders; every source record hashed into the evidence index.
NER + relation extraction -> entity resolution -> NetworkX knowledge graph with evidence-linked edges.
PageRank / betweenness / community detection computed over the undirected weighted projection.
Structural-hole + shared-anchor + temporal analysis proposed hidden-intermediary hypotheses with component confidence scores.
Findings bound to evidence records via the provenance index; counter-evidence searched and preserved.
Context-bounded summary composed with provider 'mock'; output schema-validated; deterministic fallback if invalid.
